name: 保存期間の案内と復元操作付きのごみ箱管理パネル
prompt:
Recreate a single standalone Notion Trash management panel, using the primary original screenshot crop as the authority for exact panel geometry, spacing, hierarchy, row count, icon placement, clipping, border and color. Match the crop's portrait-ish 526:598 aspect ratio (about 0.88:1), with the panel filling the canvas edge to edge and no added surrounding background or blank margins. The assigned source crop at x=294,y=391 included unrelated Recently visited cards above the actual panel; the corrected primary crop starts at x=294,y=582 and contains only the Trash panel. Do not reproduce that unrelated background.

Keep the compact original proportions: rounded white panel with a fine cool-gray outline and subtle shadow; a full-width search field at the top; one horizontal row of three compact filters; a dense vertical list of document rows with a page icon at left, title and muted prior-location subtitle, then small restore-arrow and trash-can actions aligned at far right; a fixed pale blue-gray footer across the bottom with a one-line retention notice and circular help icon at right. Preserve the source's visible row rhythm and clipping: seven rows are fully visible and the eighth Poster row is only partially visible behind the fixed footer. Do not expand the panel to show extra content. Keep icon silhouettes delicate and line-weight light.

Use the Japanese mock only as a secondary guide for Japanese labels and translated titles. Exact visible Japanese text: search placeholder 「ごみ箱のページを検索」; filters 「最後の編集者」, 「場所」, 「チーム領域」; row titles, in source order, 「制作の進め方（2）」, 「案内ページ」, 「バナーの資料」, 「掲示の資料」, 「広告枠の資料」, 「制作現場の紹介」, 「制作の進め方（2）」, and the partially visible final 「掲示の資料」. First row subtitle 「制作の方針」. Every subsequent fully visible child-page row uses 「制作の方針 / 制作の進め方（2）」; the second top-level 「制作の進め方（2）」 uses 「制作の方針」. Footer text: 「30日を過ぎたページは自動で削除されます。」 Use clean readable Japanese UI type with restrained regular and semibold weights. Preserve the original white, pale blue, and neutral-gray palette.

Do not invent extra rows, badges, avatars, selected states, added buttons, English branding, or data beyond what the original crop and Japanese mock show. Make the final panel crisp, aligned, faithful to the original reference, and legible at the source crop's proportions.
reviewNotes: v001 preserved as needs-correction: geometry matches corrected source crop, but all three filters were outlined, selected blue state was missing, and row-title weight was too heavy. Corrected crop bounds and comparison evidence are in the worker record.
